This page presents a vision statement for establishing an "open, trusting culture" centered on data. It outlines key principles including a centralized set of coherent data sources without silos, business units taking ownership of data quality, and broad access to data based on functional needs. The document emphasizes that sensitive data like customer and Rx data must be highly restricted, anonymized, and encrypted. It also highlights the importance of accessible dashboards and reports for all staff to gain a holistic view of the company, with systems instrumented for early warnings. Finally, it describes analysts as highly collaborative, proactively working across departments to validate ideas and ensure objectivity.
